name: AD8655 / AD8656
type: Low-noise precision CMOS, rail-to-rail I/O, 5 V, 1/2 ch
tagline: 2.7 nV/√Hz rail-to-rail CMOS for 2.7–5.5 V: the pick for portable and USB-powered headphone amps.

lineage.note: Sole source; first release implied by 2005 copyright. Wafers from TSMC Fab 9/2A/2B; ADI Limerick added 2023.

part_numbers.note: Single; MSOP-8 and SOIC-8. Order codes (e.g. AD8655ARZ/ARMZ) unconfirmed.
Dual; MSOP-8 (LCSC C209459) and SOIC-8. Listed on PCN 23_0068.
Automotive-grade variant seen on Octopart; not checked against ADI ordering guide.

key_specs.condition: G = 1, RL = 1 kΩ, 1 kHz, 2 V p-p

key_specs.value: 3.7 mA typ, 4.5 mA max per amplifier
250 µV max; drift 0.4 µV/°C typ, 2.3 µV/°C max
CMOS, rail-to-rail in/out, DigiTrim offset trim

reputation.summary: A niche favourite for portable and 5 V / USB-powered headphone amps. Head-Fi posters call it a 'nifty low-voltage rail-to-rail dual' that 'sounds quite nice driving headphones directly'. In Head-Fi and diyAudio comparisons it ranks below the AD8620, other things equal. Not a rolling legend in ±15 V gear.
typical_uses: USB-powered 5 V DAC buffers and headphone drivers
Low-voltage rail-to-rail preamp and buffer stages
caveats: Maximum supply about 5.5 V; a ±12 V/±15 V op-amp socket will destroy it.
Surface-mount only (MSOP-8, SOIC-8); DIP-8 sockets need an adapter.
Forum comparisons rate it below the AD8620; opinions, not measurements.
3.7 mA per amp typ is fairly high for a 5 V part, hurting battery life.

counterfeit_notes: No specific counterfeit reports found. ADI offers only MSOP-8 and SOIC-8, so any DIP-8 'AD8656' is an adapter board or suspect. Buy from authorized distributors.

silicon_changes.summary: ADI added ADI Limerick (ADLK) as an alternate fab to TSMC Fab 9/2A/2B for 0.6 µm CMOS amps; some parts moved from 6- to 8-inch wafers. Rev. - published 8 May 2023, effective 10 Aug 2023; Rev. A (more models) published 6 Feb 2024, effective 10 May 2024.
silicon_changes.identification: Not visible in the marking. Fab origin is traceable only via ADI lot or date-code records; post-Aug 2023 parts may be TSMC or Limerick wafers.

spec_deltas.before: TSMC Fab 9 / Fab 2A / Fab 2B (0.6 µm CMOS)

silicon_changes.audio_impact: None expected; data-sheet limits unchanged. Unguaranteed parameters such as the 1/f noise corner could in principle differ slightly.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: same part number and limits; ADI states no fit, form or function change.
silicon_changes.verification: PCN scope and Rev. - / Rev. A qualification reports confirmed. AD8656 listing reported; AD8655 listing unconfirmed.

silicon_changes.summary: ADI PCN 07_0024 Rev. E, the Sumitomo mold-compound discontinuation (mold compound and some die-attach changes across SOIC, MSOP/MiniSO and other packages), reportedly lists the AD8655 and AD8656. Package material only, not a die change.
silicon_changes.identification: Unknown. Use a date code after the PCN effective date.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: package-material change; no data-sheet change associated.
silicon_changes.verification: Classed as Sumitomo mold-compound change per OP275 and AD8610 records; AD8655/AD8656 rows not seen.

claims_confirmed: Current ADI datasheet is Rev. E, copyright 2005–2013 (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/ad8655_8656.pdf).
TME hosts an older Rev. B copy (https://www.tme.eu/Document/97e591a5710fdf5735cb53b51b664371/AD8655_8656.pdf).
2.7 nV/√Hz at 10 kHz, 250 µV max Vos, 0.4/2.3 µV/°C, 28 MHz, 2.7–5.5 V, −40 to +125 °C, MSOP/SOIC (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/ad8655_8656.pdf).
11 V/µs (10 kΩ); 3.7/4.5 mA per amp; 0.0007% THD+N (G = 1, 1 kΩ, 1 kHz, 2 V p-p); 220 mA (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/ad8655_8656.pdf).
ADI calls them the 'industry's lowest noise precision CMOS amplifiers', using DigiTrim (https://www.analog.com/en/products/ad8656.html).

PCN 23_0068: ADLK alternate to TSMC for 0.6 µm CMOS, includes AD8656; Rev - 2023-05-08/2023-08-10, Rev A 2024-02-06/2024-05-10 (https://www.analog.com/media/en/PCN/ADI_PCN_23_0068_Rev_A_Form.pdf, https://www.mouser.com/PCN/ADI_PCN_23_0068_Rev._A.pdf).
PCN 07_0024 Rev. E lists AD8655 and AD8656 (https://www.analog.com/media/en/pcn/ADI_PCN_07_0024_Rev_E_Form.pdf).
